title: Opening search results in a new tab increased homepage clicks

change.control: Search results open in the current tab/window.
change.variant: Open search results in a new tab/window.

quote: In April 2011, MSN in the US ran a very large experiment, with over 12M users, which opened the search results in a new tab/window, and engagement as measured by clicks per user increased by a whopping 5%.
notes: Over 12M users is a lower bound. New-tab changes can also improve click-beacon reliability; do not assume all measured clicks represent incremental behavior. Full text is also available in the author-hosted PDF at https://exp-platform.com/Documents/2014%20experimentersRulesOfThumb.pdf. The supporting quote and result were checked against that PDF; the equivalent ACM publisher full-text page returned HTTP 403 in Chromium.
